role: Skill package installer that converts validated YAML into knowledge graph nodes and edges with idempotency, dependency resolution, and atomic transaction semantics.
detail: Exports install_package() async function that orchestrates the installation pipeline: checks for existing installation, resolves dependencies (validates against installed packages + anchor layer), then atomically creates SkillPackage META_SCHEMA node, all package nodes/edges, and dependency edges. Includes _validate_call_steps() which runs four validations on ProcedureStep nodes with step_type=call: V1 target existence, V2 non-self circular call detection via 3-color DFS, V3 argument count matching, V4 warns on missing DEPENDS_ON edges. All content tagged with installed_by_skill property for clean uninstallation. Builds nodes with installed_at timestamp and edges with created_at. Default provenance confidence is 0.15 for node content, 1.0 for package metadata. Anchor layer packages (core-bootstrap, language-foundation) are always considered available.
gotchas: TODO at line 275 defers cycle detection for multi-package installations (currently single-package only). V4 validation only logs warnings, non-fatal. BFS phase 3 relies on edges_list being in YAML order; assumes no circular HAS_OPERAND edges (DAG assumption not validated). Exception at line 160-172 swallows all installation errors, logs them, and returns failure without re-raising (caller cannot distinguish between network failures vs. logic errors).
